text.en:
The additional sum of one hundred thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be respectively
necessary, are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not appropriated for other
purposes, to be disbursed by the Secretary of Labor, during the rest of the present year and during the year
nineteen hundred and thirty-seven, for traveling expenses of homeseekers, including freight of working
animals and agricultural tools.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 14, 1936.
